I told Dana in a thread reply under her message that the deadline for the signed order form at Thornbury Cloth Co. is 21 December. Marcus posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing in the channel since has changed it.

I couldn't check it against account records because there are no Thornbury files in the shared folders, so I suggested she ask Marcus to confirm before putting it in the tracker. The deadline is a date, not a money figure, so it was fine to share with the team.
